title: Apprentice Sales Advisor
description:
What's in it for you:
- A great starting salary of £22,527 rising to £26,738 after completion of the apprenticeship. Plus, an uncapped commission scheme.
- An NVQ Level 2 in Customer Service following the completion of the apprenticeship (15 months)
- Huge discounts off your Mobile and Broadband packages, starting at £10 a month
- Huge discounts off other tech such as Smart watches, speakers, tv's, gaming consoles and subscriptions
- Discount codes to give out to friends and family
- Support to carve your own career path. We're passionate about helping our people grow the career they want
- Season Ticket Travel Loan - giving you the funds to pay for your travel to and from work up front
- Online GP: Access to a private GP 24/7 for you and your immediate family

What you'll be doing

At EE, we believe every customer interaction should be a positive experience. You'll speak with customers over the phone, getting to know what matters most to them, building strong relationships, and recommending the right EE products and services to suit their needs. You'll use your energy and ambition to thrive and meet goals, and grow your skills along the way. From the latest mobile tech and broadband, and smart home solutions, every conversation is a chance to make a real impact and grow your confidence.

As part of your apprenticeship, you'll complete a 15-month NVQ Level 2 in Customer Service. We'll support you every step of the way - including one dedicated study day a week, guidance from a college tutor, and extra coaching to help you feel confident in your role.

Why choose EE

You don't need experience, all you need is a great attitude, a friendly voice, and the willingness to learn. We'll give you all the training you need and we're passionate about helping you kick start your career.

At EE, you're part of something bigger. You'll make friends, learn new skills, and build confidence every day. We're proud to be inclusive and welcome people from all backgrounds - because everyone belongs here.

Ready to make your mark? Apply now and let's start building your future.

title: Business development executive
description:
Our client is seeking a Marketing & Business Development Executive:

Are you a Marketing or Business Development professional looking to join a prestigious London law firm offering a competitive salary, Private Medical Insurance, discretionary bonus, pension, 25 days' holiday, Gymflex, wellbeing support and more? This is an excellent opportunity to join a Chambers and Legal 500 recognised firm, supporting the delivery of strategic marketing and business development initiatives within a collaborative and high-performing team.

- Prestigious London law firm consistently recognised by Chambers and The Legal 500
- Renowned for advising high-net-worth and ultra-high-net-worth individuals

- Collaborative culture with excellent career development opportunities

Marketing & Business Development Executive - Position Overview:

You will work across both marketing and business development, supporting the firm's continued growth through strategic marketing initiatives, legal directory submissions, CRM development and business development projects. Requirements of the Marketing & Business Development Executive:

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills
- Strong organisational and project management abilities
- Exceptional attention to detail and commitment to quality
- Experience working with CRM systems and Microsoft Office applications
- Experience organising events and supporting business development initiatives
- Creative approach with strong research and analytical skills
- Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines independently

The Benefits for the Marketing & Business Development Executive role:
- Competitive salary
- 25 days' holiday

- Pension Scheme

title: Business Development Executive 12-month FTC
company: Norton Rose Fulbright LLP - Agency - Permanent
description:
Practice Group / Department:

Business Development - ESG - London

Job Description

Norton Rose Fulbright is a global law firm with more than 3,000 lawyers advising clients across locations in the United States, Europe, Canada, Latin America, Asia, Australia, Africa and the Middle East. We provide a full scope of legal services to the world's preeminent corporations and financial institutions.

Our vision is to be a world class business, profitable, ambitious, cooperative and considerate, supporting our clients and people through our global business principles of Quality, Unity and Integrity.

With over 7,000 employees worldwide, our culture is the thread that connects us. Our strategy and culture are closed connected - defined by shared ambition, global collaboration and a one-team mindset. We believe pioneering work happens when people are empowered to think beyond boundaries, explore new opportunities and grow through diverse experiences. Alongside the right skills and experience, we are looking for people who are innovative, commercially minded, and motivated by the impact of the work they do - ready to share in our ambition and help shape what comes next.

Because while individuals can do well, together we achieve something extraordinary.

The Role

The Business Development Executive (BDE) role is a permanent role within NRF's London office in the Marketing & Business Development (MBD) function and the Europe, Middle East & Asia (EMEA) region at Norton Rose Fulbright.

The role reports to a Senior Business Development Manager responsible for strategic growth initiatives across sectors and practice areas, and will work closely with the Business Development Manager supporting the Real Estate, Tax and Employment practices.

This position offers the opportunity to develop specialist knowledge within these practice areas while also contributing to initiatives and campaigns that span multiple sectors, practices and regions. The role holder will work with a diverse range of colleagues across the firm, building a strong internal network and gaining valuable insight into how collaboration drives client relationships and business growth.

Working closely with business development managers and partners, the role holder will contribute to the delivery of the team's business development strategy. This includes supporting client development initiatives, marketing campaigns, events and profile-raising activities, while building effective relationships with stakeholders across the firm.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone developing their career in business development. The role provides exposure to a wide range of strategic and client-facing activities, regular interaction with partners and senior colleagues, and the opportunity to develop commercial awareness, relationship management and project management expertise.

The role holder will also work in close co-operation with colleagues across the global and EMEA Marketing and Business Development teams as well as our support team in Newcastle.

Key Responsibilities
- Producing bespoke bids, credentials, pitches, presentations and other client development and marketing content (formal and informal).
- Working with the relevant practice leadership and BD managers to create and implement business plans, budget proposals and campaign plans for the EMEA region.
- Assisting with all aspects of the planning, development and implementation of BD and marketing activity. This includes, but is not limited to, business development, client development, profile raising, marketing, communications, bids and event management.
- Acting as a key point of contact and ambassador for the practice.
- Establishing a close and effective relationship with the lawyers and partners within the practices.
- Working closely with other MBD teams, including the client relationship team, strategic bids, events, design and digital, and our Newcastle-based marketing services team.
- Coordinating and drafting directory and award submissions.
- Ensure marketing materials are kept up to date.
- Supporting the management of relevant MBD budgets, including reporting of ROI.
- Contributing and leading on best practice.

Key Skills and Experience
- Graduate calibre with demonstrable and/or professionally recognised BD, marketing or communications qualification (such as CIM, etc).
- Experience in marketing and business development is desirable, as is experience of working in a legal/professional services/partnership environment.
- Excellent written and oral communication skills, including strong attention to detail.
- Confident and willing to take on additional responsibility as required.
- Highly organised with a professional, confident, collaborative and proactive approach to their role.
- Ability to manage competing priorities, multiple tasks and stakeholders.
- Experience in managing and writing bids or similar sales writing is desirable.
- Understands the need, and has the ability, to manage expectations.

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

To attract the best people, we strive to create a diverse and inclusive environment where everyone can bring their whole selves to work, have a sense of belonging, and realize their full career potential.
Our new enabled work model allows our people to have more flexibility in the way they choose to work from both the office and a remote location, while continuing to deliver the highest standards of service. We offer a range of family friendly and inclusive employment policies and provide access to programmes and services aimed at nurturing our people's health and overall wellbeing. Find more about Diversity, Equity and Inclusion here.

We are proud to be an equal opportunities employer and encourage applications from individuals who can complement our existing teams. We strive to create an inclusive and accessible recruitment process for all candidates. If you require any tailored adjustments or accommodations, please let us know here.

title: Marketing & Business Development Executive
description:
Marketing & Business Development Executive

Prestigious Law Firm

up to £40k

London (WC2 A)

Our client, a prestigious and highly regarded London law firm, is seeking a Marketing & Business Development Executive to join its growing Business Services team.

This is a broad and varied role, offering the opportunity to work across marketing, communications and business development, supporting senior stakeholders and contributing to the firm's continued growth.

The Role

A key focus will be managing the firm's legal directory and awards programme, including:
- Managing submissions for Chambers & Partners, The Legal 500, Spear's and other relevant directories and awards.
- Co-ordinating submission deadlines and working with multiple practice areas.
- Preparing and uploading submissions, referee lists and supporting documentation.
- Keeping up to date with directory requirements, research processes and submission criteria.
- Monitoring researcher details, referee engagement and interview opportunities.
- Communicating rankings and accolades and supporting related website and LinkedIn updates.
- Supporting BD initiatives including market research, targeting, events, pitches and proposals.
- Supporting the ongoing development and data integrity of the firm's CRM system.

About You
- You will ideally have at least two years' marketing and/or business development experience from a law firm.
- Most importantly, you will have demonstrable, hands-on experience managing legal directory submissions, ideally including Chambers & Partners and/or The Legal 500. This is a key requirement for the role.
- You will have excellent communication skills, exceptional attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines.

Benefits

The firm offers an excellent benefits package, including private medical insurance, life assurance, pension, discretionary bonus, health and wellbeing benefits, dental cover, season ticket loan, cycle-to-work scheme and 25 days' annual leave.

If you would like to learn more about this opportunity, contact Matthew Heard for a confidential discussion.

LR Legal is a specialist legal recruitment agency with a reputation based on trust and integrity. We will always ask your permission before sending your CV to any of our clients.

LR Legal Recruitment is operating as an Employment Agency in respect of this vacancy.

title: Sales Coordinator
description:
UK Sales Coordinator Premium Lifestyle Brand London Up to 80,000 +Bonus

We are working with an established international lifestyle brand that is looking to appoint a UK Sales Coordinator to support the continued development of its UK & Ireland business.

This is an exciting opportunity for a commercially minded sales professional to join a growing international business and play a key role in connecting the UK market with its European headquarters.

The role will work closely with the Sales Director, based in France, as well as the wider UK commercial team, acting as an important link between the UK market, key customers and HQ.

The Role

This is a broad commercial role, supporting the UK sales operation while bringing strong UK market insight into the wider business.

You will work closely with KAMs, alongside the sales administration team, helping to coordinate commercial activity and ensure the UK market has the right support from the wider business.

Key responsibilities will include:
- Supporting the delivery of the UK commercial strategy and sales priorities.
- Building and maintaining strong relationships with key UK customers and partners.
- Supporting customer meetings, showroom appointments, seasonal activity and commercial negotiations.
- Monitoring sales performance and identifying opportunities for growth.
- Providing insight into UK market trends, competitors and customer needs.
- Working closely with European HQ across Sales, Product, Marketing, Customer Service, Finance and Supply Chain.
- Supporting forecasting, order management and resolving supply chain challenges.
- Identifying opportunities to develop new customers, channels and markets.
- Supporting product launches and local Go-to-Market activity.
- Coordinating information and ensuring the UK market is effectively represented within the wider business.

About You

We're looking for someone with strong UK commercial and market knowledge, ideally from a footwear, outdoor, lifestyle, fashion or premium consumer brand.

You may currently be working in a wholesale, account management, sales or commercial coordination role and be ready to take on a broader remit.

You'll be someone who:
- Understands the UK customer and competitive landscape.
- Has strong relationship-building and commercial skills.
- Is confident working with key accounts and commercial partners.
- Can interpret sales information and identify opportunities.
- Is highly organised and comfortable coordinating across multiple teams.
- Can build strong relationships with international stakeholders.
- Is confident bringing the UK perspective into discussions with HQ.
- Is proactive, commercially curious and comfortable working in a fast-moving environment.
- Is happy to travel to France as required.

Footwear experience would be particularly advantageous, although relevant experience across outdoor, lifestyle, fashion or premium consumer brands will also be considered.

The Opportunity

This is a role with genuine scope to influence the development of an established UK business.

You'll be joining at an interesting point in its growth, with opportunities to develop new markets and customers, strengthen the UK/HQ relationship and support the continued development of the product and customer offering.

UK Sales Coordinator Premium Lifestyle Brand London Up to 80,000 +Bonus

title: Senior Client Services Specialist
company: Everywhen, part of the Ardonagh Group - Agency - Permanent
advertiser_name: Everywhen, part of the Ardonagh Group
description:
Do you have customer service experience within employee benefits or insurance?

We're looking for a Client Services Senior Specialist to join our growing team at Everywhen Employee Benefits , part of the wider Ardonagh Advisory Group. This is a fantastic opportunity for an experienced customer service professional who is passionate about delivering exceptional client service and supporting colleagues to succeed.

You'll work Monday to Friday, 37.5 hours per week, with no evenings or weekends, and benefit from all the advantages of working within a supportive, well-established organisation that truly puts clients and people first.

This is a remote first role so previous experience in the employee benefits space is highly desirable.

So, what does the role of Client Services Senior Specialist involve?

In this role, you will provide exceptional client service and support to Consultants, clients, and insurers, acting as a trusted and knowledgeable first point of contact.

Your key responsibilities will include:
- Being the first point of contact for day-to-day queries from clients, Consultants, and insurers via phone and email.
- Proactively supporting policy renewals and new business, ensuring all activity is handled efficiently, accurately, and in line with agreed SLAs.
- Managing the day-to-day running of an assigned client portfolio, including invoicing, accounts, claims, underwriting, and administration.
- Preparing draft client reports for renewals and new business requests.
- Ensuring all work is completed right first time, maintaining high standards of accuracy and compliance with FCA, Consumer Duty, and data protection requirements.
- Keeping client records and information fully up to date within our Policy Administration System.
- Acting as a role model within the team, demonstrating strong client service behaviours, technical knowledge, and professionalism.
- Supporting the Team Manager with task delegation, mentoring, training of new or existing team members, and occasional involvement in interviews.
- Taking ownership of referrals and escalations, ensuring timely resolution and excellent outcomes.
- Proactively identifying opportunities to improve processes, service delivery, and ways of working.

What are we looking for?
- Proven customer service experience within financial services or insurance (minimum 3 years).
- Experience within Group Risk or Healthcare or Employee Benefits (minimum 3 years).
- Strong organisation and time management skills, with the ability to manage priorities and meet deadlines.
- Excellent communication skills and confidence dealing with clients and insurers at all levels.
- High attention to detail and a strong sense of ownership over your work.
- A positive, flexible team player who enjoys supporting others and leading by example.
- Microsoft Office skills (essential).
- Industry qualifications such as IF7 or GR1 are desirable, but not essential.

What's in it for you?
- A welcoming, supportive team environment
- The opportunity to work for an organisation awarded Investors in Customers Gold for outstanding service.
- Hybrid working options once established in the role.
- Ongoing training, development, and support with professional qualifications.
- A company culture that genuinely cares about your wellbeing, development, and career progression.

If you're passionate about client service, enjoy working collaboratively, and are ready to take the next step in your career within Health & Protection, we'd love to hear from you.

Everywhen is an equal opportunities employer, with a growing and thriving diversity, equity and inclusion strategy; we are committed to a working environment that is free from discrimination, is inclusive, and empowers our people to bring their whole self to work and reach their full potential.

If your application is successful, we will conduct relevant employment checks prior to you commencing employment with us. These will include verifying your recent employment, address, credit history and a standard criminal record check.

As an Everywhen colleague, you will be expected to uphold our values, act professionally and respectfully towards others, and contribute to a workplace where everyone is treated with dignity and respect. We expect all colleagues to help maintain an environment free from bullying, harassment, victimisation and other inappropriate behaviours, supporting our commitment to an inclusive and high-performing culture.

Please note: We may close a vacancy prior to the publish end date if the required quality or number of applications has been received. No Agencies please.
